# Two-factor challenge
{: .no_toc }

Complete sign-in with a TOTP code or a recovery code.
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

| | |
|---|---|
| **Screen ID** | `AUTH-02` |
| **Route** | `/sign-in/mfa` · deep link `substratal://sign-in/mfa` |
| **Who can use it** | Holder of mfa_token |
| **Kind** | auth |
| **Available in** | All Hub apps (MVP) |
| **On Linux** | Separate `AdwWindow` with `AdwClamp` |

**How you get here:** AUTH-01 returned MfaChallenge

## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules | On Linux |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Code | otp-field | body.code | 6 digits; paste fills all; auto-submit on 6th digit; OS one-time-code autofill | AdwEntryRow input-purpose=digits |
| Use a recovery code | link | swaps to Recovery code field | only if `methods` includes recovery_code | GtkButton .flat / GtkLinkButton |
| Recovery code | text-field | body.recovery_code | format xxxx-xxxx; case-insensitive | AdwEntryRow |
| Expiry countdown | caption | MfaChallenge.expires_in | announce at 60 s and 10 s | GtkLabel .caption .dim-label |
| Verify | primary-button | POST /auth/mfa/verify |  | GtkButton .suggested-action .pill |

## What happens when you act

| Action | API call | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Verify | `POST /auth/mfa/verify` | 200 → same as AUTH-01 success. 401 → "That code didn't work." clear field. Expired → back to AUTH-01 with message. 429 → countdown. |

## Good to know

- **Loading, empty and error states:** Challenge expired
